page_title: BOL 4-0 LEC | Bologna v Lecce 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Lecce enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
89' Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Lecce fail to score from a corner as Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) leaps to collect the ball.
86' 6:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
86' The Bologna players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
82' 4 - 0 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Jens Odgaard (Bologna), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 4:0.
80' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
78' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Lewis Ferguson and he is replaced by Nikola Moro (Bologna).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hamza Rafia (Lecce) comes onto the pitch so that Remi Oudin can be given a rest.
76' Great teamplay by Lecce as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
75' Remi Oudin (Lecce) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
73' Bologna players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
70' A player from Lecce commits a rough challenge. Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
67' Remo Freuler comes off the pitch to be replaced by Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna).
65' Lecce hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
61' Substitution. Riccardo Orsolini makes way for Dan Ndoye (Bologna).
61' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Joshua Zirkzee will be replaced by Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
61' Substitution. Stefan Posch makes his way off the pitch and Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) comes on as his replacement.
59' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
57' The referee blows his whistle, Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
54' A player from Bologna commits a rough challenge. Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
52' It looks like Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) saw red with that tackle. Gianluca Manganiello won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
51' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Nikola Krstovic is replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Lecce).
49' 3 - 0 After receiving a sweet pass, Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) unleashes a shot straight into the top left corner. Good team effort!
49' Bologna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' Half-time substitution. Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) will not participate anymore and Alexis Blin is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is replaced by Patrick Dorgu.
46' The whistle blows and Gianluca Manganiello starts the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
44' A corner kick by Bologna is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
44' A player from Lecce pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) was quite harsh and Gianluca Manganiello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' Nicola Sansone comes onto the pitch because Lameck Banda (Lecce) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
36' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
36' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) lashes the free kick from the edge of the box but it flies high over the bar, somewhere into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
34' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) has tested the patience of referee Gianluca Manganiello and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
30' Some neat passing and movement from Bologna as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
27' 2 - 0 Clinical finish! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) finds himself some space inside the box to control a rebound and buries his shot into the bottom right corner of the net.
24' Lecce are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
22' Lukasz Skorupski makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) after a cross from the side.
21' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes.

17' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
15' Lameck Banda (Lecce) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Gianluca Manganiello stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.

13' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
10' Bologna keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
8' Referee Gianluca Manganiello sees the trip by Remi Oudin (Lecce) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Sam Beukema (Bologna) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
5' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
2' Gianluca Manganiello interrupts the game. One of the players from Bologna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Lecce will take the kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello will supervise the game today.
